messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for inference-service v2.2.0 -> targets: 5% -> 15% -> 30%. Change window 01:30-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.2.0
ash: kicking off now. includes tokenizer stability fix + small batching tweak. watching token-parse-errors and 95p latency.
tori: spotted a blip in APAC at 5% (token-parse-errors +0.09%). pulling samples. :mag_right:
diego: 50/95 latency unchanged. any pattern in failures?
tori: errors tied to requests with long-system messages; stack shows `tokenizer_v=legacy` used on some nodes. looks like a config drift in apac pool.
anya: recommendation: pause APAC progression and pin APAC to v2.1.8 until we confirm. EU/US can continue to 15%.
ash: agreed. executing regional pin for APAC.
deploy-bot: Executing pin: inference-service region=apac -> pinned to v2.1.8. APAC traffic: 0% v2.2.0. (job id: db-51001)
diego: I'll trigger an apac rebuild with corrected config and run failing prompt set. ETA ~8m.
tori: reproducer for infra: `curl -H "X-Region: apac" https://staging-infer/parse -d "prefix=<<long>>"` -> `unexpected_tokenization`
anya: extending change window by 20m to accommodate verification. Logged.
deploy-bot: Build queued: build-7921. Will post smoke results.
diego: rebuild done, smoke passed. artifact v2.2.0-configfix uploaded. Ready to unpin+soft-canary on APAC. react :shipit: to proceed.
anya: :shipit: from oncall. proceed with 5% soft-canary in APAC.
nash: unpin+rollout 5% APAC now. monitoring token-parse-errors and client failures for 30m.
deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: APAC -> 5% v2.2.0-configfix, 95% pinned v2.1.8. Canary flag active.
tori: 25m in, token-parse-errors back to baseline and no regressions in sample set.
ash: good. leave EU at 15% and US progression paused until we finish post-canary checks. reconvene in 10m. :thumbsup:
